fusions.name: Cropping Sweep
fusions.desc: You crop through everything in a 2-tile arc ahead, dealing 7 damage and healing you for 20% of the damage dealt. Each hit has a 30% chance of [Fatigued] for 5 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Last Mouthful
fusions.desc: A trampling stamp on a target at or below 25% health for 18 damage, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.4 times their remaining damage. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Nosebag for All
fusions.desc: Restores 12 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast. Your movement speed rises 15% for 6 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Full Belly, Long Road
fusions.desc: Whenever you are healed, you restore 6 stamina. Once every 4 seconds.
